observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor paved area in front of a building with parked cars and a tour bus, surrounded by a seated crowd
observation.dancers: Mixed group of children and youths; solo performers take turns dancing in the center while others sit around
observation.formation_and_space: Large seated semi-circle surrounding an open central dancing space
observation.posture: Upright torso with slight forward lean during energetic footwork, knees bent
observation.footwork: Bouncy stepping, high-knee lifting, stamping, and quick pivoting on the balls of the feet
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held out to the sides or swinging naturally with the rhythm; clapping by seated participants
observation.hips_and_torso: Energetic hip movement and shifting weight from side to side
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low to medium level, small jumps, squatting, and quick spins
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional-style fringe skirts, beaded accessories, headbands, and varied casual tops
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and weight transfer details due to distant camera framing and rapid movement

signature_moments.what: Dancer in white top and fringed skirt performs high-knee stepping and pivots rapidly
Two dancers simultaneously perform rapid high-stepping and low squats in circles
Solo dancer in animal print costume spins quickly while maintaining rhythmic stamping
